items.titleZh: 挑战在无摩擦和风险中驾驭速度
items.summaryZh: 埃里克·恩斯特表示，#SecuringSpeed 意味着在不产生摩擦和风险的情况下驾驭速度，并探讨了人工智能在车队中的应用以及 Zscaler 的 #ZeroTrust 基础如何实现快速安全。

media.altZh: 挑战在无摩擦和风险中驾驭速度 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: "The challenge is to harness speed, without friction and risk. That's what #SecuringSpeed means to us, and to @Zscaler." Eric Ernst, Commercial Techno...
items.summaryEn:
"The challenge is to harness speed, without friction and risk. That's what #SecuringSpeed means to us, and to @Zscaler." Eric Ernst, Commercial Technology Ambassador
Discover how AI is making a difference across the team, and why Zscaler’s #ZeroTrust foundation enables security at speed.
detailZh:
“挑战在于如何驾驭速度，同时避免摩擦和风险。这就是对我们来说，#SecuringSpeed 的意义，以及对于 @Zscaler 来说是什么。” 艾瑞克·恩斯特，商业技术大使
了解人工智能如何在整个团队中发挥作用，以及为什么 Zscaler 的 #ZeroTrust 基础设施能够实现快速安全。
detailEn:
"The challenge is to harness speed, without friction and risk. That's what #SecuringSpeed means to us, and to @Zscaler." Eric Ernst, Commercial Technology Ambassador
Discover how AI is making a difference across the team, and why Zscaler’s #ZeroTrust foundation enables security at speed.
